cause.explanation: The Stage 3.2 post_repair_diagnostic.json was captured from an intermediate diagnostic script state that still exhibited the pre-repair finite-gap progress teleport (pass_deltas[0] ≈ 1e-4). Production R3 repairs and the independent pytest later yielded exact zero deltas; the named JSON was not regenerated after that repair, so the checked-in post-repair file remained stale while the Stage 3.2 report and unit tests reflected the fixed behavior.

defect.summary: Saved post-repair R3 diagnostic still records a finite-gap progress jump inconsistent with repaired production code and test_r3_overtake_no_free_distance_on_finite_gap.

preservation_policy: Original bytes preserved; do not overwrite under the Stage 3.2 path.
